title: Multi-target Parallel Drug Discovery with Multi-agent Orchestration

contributions.purpose: 构建模块化多智能体端到端早期药物发现框架
contributions.mechanism: Abstract Mining→Target Evaluator→Medicinal Chemist选ChEMBL种子→MolMIM生成→Molecule Evaluator级联过滤(hERG/溶解度/稳定性/potency)+XGBoost ADME-Tox
contributions.evaluation: 应用阿尔茨海默病,识别SGLT2/CGAS/SEH/HDAC/DYRK1A五靶点
contributions.source_quote: We introduce a modular, multi-agent framework that autonomously navigates the early-stage drug discovery pipeline, from target identification to the generation of optimized hit candidates.

contributions.purpose: 对4/5靶点成功生成高potency新骨架
contributions.evaluation: SGLT2/SEH/HDAC/DYRK1A median AUPRC 0.80-0.89,生成分子bioactivity常>0.90;hERG AUROC 0.82/AUPRC 0.79,LogS Spearman 0.78
contributions.source_quote: successfully generated novel molecular scaffolds with high predicted potency and favorable drug-like properties for four of the targets.

contributions.purpose: 揭示数据稀缺决定自主系统性能上限(负结果)
contributions.mechanism: CGAS数据稀缺致模型失败;微粒体半衰期端点难预测
contributions.evaluation: CGAS AUPRC仅0.60(数据100正/146负,近随机);微粒体半衰期AUROC 0.46失败被剔除;需人工调阈值缓解类别不平衡
contributions.source_quote: The framework's failure to build a reliable model for the data-scarce target, CGAS, highlights a key limitation: the performance of autonomous systems is fundamentally tethered to the quality and availability of the underlying data.

contributions.purpose: 并行探索手稿自动生成的智能体框架
contributions.evaluation: 定性;自认非自主程序而由手工迭代prompt模拟
contributions.source_quote: we explore a parallel agentic framework for the automated generation of the scientific manuscript itself.

self_declared_provenance.quote: our work differs by proposing an explicit and transparent multi-agent architecture, offering a modular framework that can be understood and adapted by the broader research community.

notes: 唯一accept篇,真实署名(UAB),诚实报告负结果:CGAS AUPRC 0.60(数据稀缺100/146)、微粒体半衰期AUROC 0.46(剔除出过滤级联)、需人工curate活性阈值(pIC50阈从6.0调至7.8等)。诚实披露:手稿生成'framework'非自主程序而是'a sequence of manual, iterative interactions...simulating the described agentic workflow';Figure1由nano-banana从手绘草图生成。checklist诚实:Broader impacts[NA]自认'societal impacts are overlooked'、'skimmed the CoE';Hypothesis[C]自评70% AI,实验/分析/写作[D]。AI自曝局限:gemini-2.5-pro迭代后失控幻觉,claude-opus-4.1'generated the same ML training despite the difference in the dataset'(潜在代码复用bug)。小瑕疵:正文'Table 4.1'异常交叉引用;详细分类指标(AUC-ROC/F1)仅在repo未入正文;全为in silico预测,无体外验证(已披露)。
